dishes.n: Peggy Hodgson's sausage rolls with brown sauce
dishes.make_ahead: Roll and chill the uncooked rolls up to 1 day ahead, or freeze for 1 month; brush with egg and bake from cold

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C and line a tray. Mix the sausage mince with the onion, sage and white pepper.
Cut each pastry sheet in half, lay a log of filling along each strip, roll up and press the seam closed.
Cut each roll into 4, put seam side down on the tray and brush with the egg.
Bake until puffed and deep golden.
Cool for 5 minutes and serve warm with the brown sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Roll and chill the uncooked rolls up to 1 day ahead, or freeze for 1 month; brush with egg and bake from cold

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C and line a tray. Squeeze the vegetarian sausages out of their skins and mix with the onion, sage and white pepper.
Cut each pastry sheet in half, lay a log of filling along each strip, roll up and press the seam closed.
Cut each roll into 4, put seam side down on the tray and brush with the egg.
Bake until puffed and deep golden.
Cool for 5 minutes and serve warm with the brown sauce.

dishes.n: Bill Wilkins's armchair cheese and pickle toasties
dishes.make_ahead: Assemble the toasties up to 4 hours ahead, wrap and chill; fry just before serving

steps.text: Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Turn 4 slices butter side down, spread thinly with mustard, pile on the cheddar and pickle and close with the other slices, butter side up.
Fry in a frying pan over medium low heat, pressing with a spatula, for 4 minutes a side until golden and melted. Do it in two batches.
Cut into triangles and serve hot.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the pie to the cheddar stage up to 2 days ahead and chill, or freeze for 1 month; bake from cold for 40 minutes

steps.text: Cook the onion, carrots and celery in the oil in a large pan over medium heat until soft.
Turn up the heat, add the lamb mince and brown it well, breaking it up.
Stir in the tomato paste and flour, then the stock, worcestershire and thyme. Simmer gently, stirring now and then, until thick.
Meanwhile boil the potatoes until tender, drain and mash with the butter and milk. Season with salt and pepper.
Stir the peas through the mince, season and tip into a 2 litre baking dish. Heat the oven to 200C.
Spread the mash over the top, rough it up with a fork and scatter with the cheddar.
Bake until the top is golden and the edges bubble.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

veg.make_ahead: Make the pie to the cheddar stage up to 2 days ahead and chill, or freeze for 1 month; bake from cold for 40 minutes

steps.text: Cook the onion, carrots and celery in the oil in a large pan over medium heat until soft.
Turn up the heat, add the mushrooms and cook until dark and dry, then stir in the lentils.
Stir in the tomato paste and flour, then the stock, soy sauce and thyme. Simmer gently, stirring now and then, until thick.
Meanwhile boil the potatoes until tender, drain and mash with the butter and milk. Season with salt and pepper.
Stir the peas through the lentils, season and tip into a 2 litre baking dish. Heat the oven to 200C.
Spread the mash over the top, rough it up with a fork and scatter with the cheddar.
Bake until the top is golden and the edges bubble.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

dishes.n: Janet's school jam roly-poly with custard
dishes.make_ahead: Make the custard up to 2 days ahead and reheat gently; roll and wrap the pudding up to 4 hours ahead and chill, then bake

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C. Rub the butter into the flour, sugar and salt, then stir in the milk for the dough to make a soft dough.
Roll out on a floured bench to 30cm by 20cm, spread with the jam leaving a 2cm border, roll up from a short side and pinch the ends closed.
Wrap loosely in buttered baking paper, then foil, and sit it on a rack over a roasting tin half full of boiling water.
Bake until risen and firm.
Meanwhile heat the milk for the custard. Whisk the yolks, custard sugar and cornflour, pour on the hot milk, return to the pan and stir over low heat until thick, then add the vanilla.
Rest the pudding for 5 minutes, slice thickly and serve with the hot custard.

dishes.make_ahead: Stud the lemon slices with cloves up to 4 hours ahead; boil the kettle and build each glass to serve

ingredients.item: lemon, half juiced and half cut into 4 slices

steps.text: Press 2 cloves into each lemon slice.
Divide the honey, lemon juice and whisky between 4 heatproof glasses.
Top with the boiling water, stir, add a lemon slice and a piece of cinnamon stick to each and steep for a few minutes.
Serve hot.

af.n: Enfield night watch hot honey tea
af.make_ahead: Stud the lemon slices with cloves up to 4 hours ahead; boil the kettle and build each glass to serve

ingredients.item: lemon, half juiced and half cut into 4 slices

steps.text: Steep the tea bags and ginger in the boiling water for 4 minutes, then lift out the tea bags.
Press 2 cloves into each lemon slice.
Divide the honey and lemon juice between 4 heatproof glasses.
Pour in the hot ginger tea, stir, add a lemon slice and a piece of cinnamon stick to each and steep for a few minutes.
Serve hot.
